newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FOUR STOCKS TO BE REMOVED FROM A GROUP.
newsitem.headline: FOUR STOCKS TO BE REMOVED FROM A GROUP.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that its board decided to delist the securities of four companies from the A group and place them on the B group from August 25.
"The stocks of Sastatas, Grafobal Vilnius, LITHUN and Klovainiu Skalda will be moved from the A group to B list," Saulius Malinauskas, the head of the bourse's listing department, told Reuters.

"After analysing the trading results with the securities of the four companies during the first seven months of the year the board of the stock exchange decided that their liquidity was too low for the A group ," Malinauskas said.
Malinauskas said that the stocks of Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery, Panevezio Statybos Trestas construction company and Zhiemys, a fur coat maker, will be listed on the A group from August 25.
Currently the A group of the Vilnius bourse is comprised of 45 stocks, Malinauskas said.
